note: Phase evals. Build a sandbox with fixture.sh, run the brief with a fresh agent, grade with grade.py. Turn config.sh on first and off afterwards.

evals.name: preflight-ok
evals.expected: done report, repo facts in context.md, nothing modified

evals.name: preflight-collision
evals.expected: blocked, trigger collision, names the existing branch

evals.name: branch
evals.expected: branch testuser/feat/PROJ-108-add-multiply-function in a worktree from origin/main

evals.name: build
evals.expected: one conventional commit with test and code, exit 0, sub() bug noted not fixed

evals.name: final-run-pass
evals.expected: all exit files 0, report done, nothing edited

evals.name: final-run-fail
evals.expected: nonzero test exit, report failed, nothing edited

evals.name: review-spec
evals.expected: blocking finding for the missing A3 TypeError requirement

evals.name: review-security
evals.expected: blocking high or medium finding on settings.py, secret value not echoed

evals.name: publish-ok
evals.expected: pushed, one draft PR with a full body, Ready eligible yes

evals.name: publish-secret
evals.expected: blocked with trigger security, nothing pushed, no PR

evals.name: ci-none
evals.expected: no checks counts as passed, PR marked ready

evals.name: ci-fail
evals.expected: draft kept, blocked with trigger ci failure, log saved

evals.name: ci-pass-notready
evals.expected: checks pass but publish said not eligible, PR stays a draft
